claims.text: Tác phẩm có thật, tên: al-Kashf ʿan manahij al-adilla (al-Kashf ʿan manāhij al-adilla fī ʿaqāʾid al-milla)

sources.quote: The Exposition of the Methods of Proof concerning Religious Doctrines (al-Kashf ʿan manāhij al-adilla fī ʿaqāʾid al-milla)
Ibn Rushd, shortly after writing his Decisive Treatise, wrote a treatise on the doctrine of God known as Al-Kashf ‘an Manahij al-Adilla
Al-Kashf ʿan manāhij al-adilla fī ʿaqāʾid al-milla (Exposition of the Methods of Proof concerning Religious Doctrines) (1179/80?)
Exposition of the Methods of Proof concerning Religious Doctrines) (1179/80?)

notes: Kiểm lại 5.1b: years_ok 1180 và year_note '1179/80, chưa chắc' khớp SEP ibn-rushd (mở lại trong phiên; SEP ghi kèm dấu hỏi).
